name: Casual Leave (CL)
description: Intended for short personal matters, family events and emergencies.

name: Sick Leave (SL)
description: For medical recovery, physician consultation, and illness.

name: Earned / Privilege Leave (EL)
description: Accrued annual vacation leave; can be encashed upon retirement or separation.

name: Compensatory Off (CO)
description: Earned by working on weekend shifts, site emergencies or government holidays.

name: Field Duty Leave (FDL)
description: Rest and recuperation (R&R) granted following extended continuous camp tours.

name: Maternity / Paternity Leave
description: Statutory 26 weeks paid maternity leave under Indian Maternity Benefit Act.
